dedupe_keys.name: energy community annual profiles for 51 buildings and ten appliance classes

description: The GECAD group at the Polytechnic of Porto constructed an annual electricity dataset for fifty residential households and one municipal-library profile. Real consumption and photovoltaic profiles from Portugal, Britain and France were normalized, scaled and assigned to a synthetic community. Ten appliance classes were allocated within the household consumption profiles, and fifteen buildings received photovoltaic generation. Zenodo provides an Excel workbook free under CC BY 4.0. The current version 2 corrects weather data; the original deposit cited by the article remains part of the provenance. Geographic coverage describes the source measurements, not a single observed neighbourhood, and the metadata do not establish one shared calendar year for all inputs. Random allocation and scaling limit behavioural interpretation as measured household activity. A reviewer-assessed use is comparing community energy-management or appliance scheduling simulations. data-low-carbon-london-smart-meter-households and data-refit-smart-homes-uk are explicitly related source collections. No workbook values or allocation algorithms were executed.
